scope: Checks the production hook, named/archetype MultiMesh geometry, source preservation, zero new collision and nonmutating supported viewpoint queries. Native GPU runs read every uploaded named-part transform and then make five labelled safe-ground fixture placements, preserving the production camera collision and original avatar, checking actual facade-part projection/physics LOS and saving five PNGs. These fixtures are not a continuous walking route. Headless dummy runs defer native transforms and images. Official photo observations, authored interpretation and direct visual acceptance remain distinct; performance and real-building access are outside this check.
